title: Mavs' Luka Doncic's Rookie Card Sets A Record As It Goes For $3.12 Million
htmlContent:
Luka Dončić continues to break records on and off the court… his National Treasures Rookie NBA Logoman Patch 2018 card, a 1-of-1, has just been auctioned off for 3.12 million dollars!

The ultra-rare card sold at a PWGSC auction on Thursday evening… has set a new record for a basketball card sold at a public auction.

The card features an image of the 23-year-old hoop star on the front, as well as a patch of a sweater he wore in his rookie year and an autograph.

The back had a quote from Luka's rookie season when he was laughing that he would retire if he dunked on LeBron James.

"This is the highest price ever realized for a basketball card sold in a verified public auction," said Jesse Craig, Vice President of Sales at PWCC Marketplace.

"When this card went to the block, we purposefully avoided speculation on a price because this was an important moment for the market to decide on the value of Luka's best trading card."

Speaking of LBJ… the all-time record for a basketball playing card is $5.2 million-- that a collector paid in a private sale (not an auction) for an Exquisite LeBron James Upper Deck card.
